title: HUD Registry Index
description: Shape of registry/index.json -- the Registry's machine-readable Theme discovery metadata (HUD Theme Contract 1.0 §2.3, §12; Architecture §27-29, §34; Story #1). This is generated by scripts/build/build-registry.ts from the already-built dist/themes/** packages -- never hand-edited (Arch §2.3).

semver.description: Strict SemVer 2.0.0 MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH (Contract §4.2); no pre-release or build metadata in 1.0.

registryRelPath.description: Registry-root-relative path into an IMMUTABLE published Theme package (dist/themes/<id>/<version>/..., Contract §2.1, §4.3). Distinct from this index file itself, which is MUTABLE discovery metadata served with a short cache policy (Arch §34) -- see registry/schemas/README.md.

package.description: Path to this version's published package root (Contract §2.2) -- the immutable versioned asset location this Story's AC requires the index to expose.

latest.description: The highest built version by SemVer comparison (Contract §4.4) -- a mutable discovery convenience, never an immutable URL.

versions.description: Every built version of this Theme, ascending by SemVer (Story #1 AC: semver-aware ordering, not lexicographic).

schemaVersion.description: Version of this registry-index.schema.json shape (independent of any Theme's own manifest schemaVersion, Arch §30-31).

themes.description: One entry per Theme id found under dist/themes/**, sorted by id (Story #1 AC: deterministic, byte-identical output for identical dist/ input).
